note.ja: Gνを物質が受け取る四元力と定義した模式形。Rは放射の応力エネルギー、Pは放射圧テンソル。M1は角度モーメントの閉包で、放射分布全体を厳密に解くものではありません。文献解説のみ。
note.en: Schematic moment system defining Gν as the four-force received by matter. R is radiation stress-energy and P the radiation-pressure tensor. M1 closes angular moments rather than exactly resolving the full distribution. Literature-only.
